\begin{minipage}{0.95\linewidth}\footnotesize Trends and steps in PSU per decade (step in PSU); the start-year and end-year blocks are the least-squares trend of annual values with the lag-one coefficient bias-corrected (Methods). Step scan over 2012--2020: the supremum-|t| statistic is $3.40$ with supremum p $0.040$ (10{,}000 simulations), so no step year is resolved. The covariate row adds the observation weights of both limbs to the time trend; the northward-weight coefficient is $-0.27$ (p $0.26$) and the southward-weight coefficient is $0.035$ (p $0.39$). The supremum rows give the supremum of the absolute \(t\) statistic over the knots and its simulated p value, with the default lag-one coefficient and with the coefficient fixed at the value of the full record (sensitivity).\end{minipage}
